fields.Name: Comedy Cabana
fields.Short Description: Ticketed stand-up shows in a club-style comedy room on North Kings Highway, a favorite with locals and tourists since 1996. Touring headliners with TV and streaming credits appear throughout the month, and the club also hosts an open mic and group bookings, with a full bar.
fields.Hours Note: Show times and tickets are listed on each show page.
fields.Address: 9588 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29572

fields.Name: Tin Roof
fields.Short Description: A live-music bar and restaurant near the Boardwalk with two floors, multiple bars and a rooftop bar with ocean views. Bands and DJs play, with country acts on weekends, and the menu leans toward hand-breaded tenders and wings. College and NFL football are shown in season, and group party packages are available.
fields.Address: 1410 N Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577

fields.Name: The Pier at Garden City Beach
fields.Short Description: A no-frills pier party with karaoke and dancing to classic rock and more.
fields.Address: 110 S Waccamaw Dr, Garden City Beach, SC 29576

fields.Name: Club Vybe
fields.Short Description: Named by Ryan; not found in sources yet. Needs verification.

fields.Name: Apache Pier
fields.Short Description: An oceanfront pier with summer bands playing hits from every decade. Family friendly.

fields.Name: Pirate's Cove Lounge
fields.Short Description: A seasonal oceanfront rooftop club above a country dance hall. Open late spring and summer.
fields.Address: 205 Main St, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582

fields.Name: Duck's Beach Club
fields.Short Description: A historic beach club built around shag dancing and beach music.
fields.Address: 229 Main St, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582

fields.Name: OD Arcade & Lounge
fields.Short Description: A low-key lounge with live music, karaoke, dancing, pool tables and an arcade.
fields.Address: 100 S Ocean Blvd, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582

fields.Name: Ocean Annie's Beach Bar
fields.Short Description: An oceanfront beach bar with live music on the pool deck most nights, plus dancing.

fields.Name: Spanish Galleon Night Club
fields.Short Description: A dance club of more than 50 years with a big dance floor and live local bands playing classic and modern hits.
fields.Address: 100 N Ocean Blvd, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582

fields.Name: Master's Club
fields.Short Description: Named by Ryan; not found in sources yet. Needs verification.

fields.Name: 3001 Nightlife
fields.Short Description: Three clubs under one roof: Club Rewind for shag and beach music, Bourbon Cowboy for country and line dancing, and Club Envy for hip-hop and house DJs.
fields.Address: 920 Lake Arrowhead Rd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29572

fields.Name: Crocodile Rocks Dueling Pianos
fields.Short Description: Dueling pianos, live music and comedy. Needs address and open/closed check.

fields.Name: Señor Frog's
fields.Short Description: A themed party club at Broadway at the Beach with DJs, plus a quieter back patio with a live band and waterfront views.

fields.Name: The Bowery
fields.Short Description: A country honky tonk with live music every night and room to dance.

fields.Name: House of Blues
fields.Short Description: A concert hall at Barefoot Landing with national touring acts, local bands on The Deck and a Sunday Gospel Brunch.
fields.Hours Note: Moved to Live Shows & Sports (Concert hall) on Nov 6, 2026.
fields.Address: 4640 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582

fields.Name: Hot Fish Club
fields.Short Description: Live music on a salt-marsh patio with a lawn for dancing and bonfires. Mainly a restaurant, so held back from the site.

fields.Name: Dead Dog Saloon
fields.Short Description: A MarshWalk landmark with live country, classic rock and blues at night, overlooking the marsh.

fields.Name: Fat Harold's Beach Club
fields.Short Description: The self-proclaimed "Home of the Shag" in the Ocean Drive section of North Myrtle Beach, with shag lessons and a State Dance lesson during the week and DJs seven nights a week. Live beach-music bands play during big event weeks. It entered the Carolina Beach Music Awards Hall of Fame in 1996, and the Shag City Grill serves food inside.
fields.Hours Note: Opens 4 PM Mon-Thu and Sun, 11 AM Fri and Sat; closing time not posted, call ahead. DJs nightly at 7 PM.
fields.Address: 212 Main St, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582

fields.Name: Carolina Improv Company
fields.Short Description: Fully improvised comedy shows. Reportedly moved to Long Bay Theatre; address needs confirming before publishing.
